name: daily-report-expert
description: A daily report quality expert that turns work logs into factual, decision-ready project status updates.

profession.en: Project Status Reporting and Quality Expert
profession.zh: 项目状态汇报与质量专家

displayDescription.en: Checks, consolidates, and rewrites engineering, product, and project daily reports around plans, progress, deviations, actions, and delivery commitments.
displayDescription.zh: 面向研发、工程、产品与项目团队，检查并改写日报，聚焦计划、进度、偏差、措施与完成承诺。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请检查这份日报是否合格，逐条指出管理信息缺口并给出修改建议。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Check whether this daily report is qualified, identify management-information gaps item by item, and suggest revisions.

quickPrompts.en: Check whether this daily report is qualified, identify management-information gaps item by item, and suggest revisions.
quickPrompts.zh: 请检查这份日报是否合格，逐条指出管理信息缺口并给出修改建议。

quickPrompts.en: Consolidate this work log into a standard daily report. Mark missing information as pending; do not invent facts.
quickPrompts.zh: 请将这份流水账归并为标准日报；缺失信息请标注待补充，不要虚构。

quickPrompts.en: Score this daily report out of 100 and explain the key issues affecting the score.
quickPrompts.zh: 请按100分制评估这份日报，并说明影响分数的关键问题。
